## Deferred this round — hard-serial on `packages/rest/src/index.ts`, which is the file the fix for #17672 has to edit

`domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), 2026-09-12T06:40Z. This card is next in this lane's order after #17672 and is **not** being dispatched alongside it. 「延后不是搁置,被延后那一刻就把已知的坑记到该卡上」, so:

**The collision.** This card's own body names four sites, one of which is `packages/rest/src/index.ts`. **#17672** was dispatched this round (order [`5644242643`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17672#issuecomment-5644242643)) under a triage ruling whose **only** permitted route is *export `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` / `repeatedQueryParamMessage` from `@objectstack/rest`'s entry* — i.e. editing that exact barrel is not incidental to that card, it **is** that card. ⇒ same file, and 同文件硬串行.

**Release condition: the MERGE of #17672's PR, ⛔ not its arm.** That card additionally carries `needs:contract-review` with `Clause-②: yes`, so its PR does not even enqueue until an at-tier contract review of record exists — expect the fence to hold longer than a typical landing.

⚠️ **A second thing to carry forward, and it may shrink this card.** #17672 makes exactly one of the two symbols this card would touch reachable from the barrel. Whoever picks this card up after that lands should re-read its census **on the post-merge tree** before assuming the "THREE copies" count still stands: the shape of a consolidation card changes when one of the copies acquires a legitimate shared home in the meantime. ⛔ Do not carry the count forward from the body without re-deriving it.

This card keeps `pm:queue` and no assignee — it is genuinely available, just not to a batch that would have to serialise behind a contract review to write its first line. ⛔ Nothing here is a re-grading; triage's `priority:p2` / `Bug` / `domain:cli` stand untouched.

## Fence RELEASED — and #17815's landing changed one of this card's stated premises

`domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), 2026-09-12T09:06Z. The hard-serial fence recorded at [`5644246414`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17681#issuecomment-5644246414) is lifted: **PR #17815 merged** as `2b08a7299cbd53edfaeaa9d949da71cc1c8471b1` at 09:02:04Z, so `packages/rest/src/index.ts` is free. ⇒ this card is dispatchable by file face.

### ⭐ The premise that moved — read this before taking the card

This card's third row explains why `packages/runtime`'s copy is a copy:

> `@objectstack/runtime` **does** depend on `@objectstack/rest`, but that package declares exactly one export subpath (`"."`) and re-exports nothing from `error-response`, so importing the predicate would mean **widening rest's published surface for an internal read**.

That was recorded as the reason the option was effectively closed. **#17672 has now widened that exact barrel** — `export { refuseRepeatedQueryParams, repeatedQueryParamMessage } from './query-multiplicity.js'` at `packages/rest/src/index.ts:70` — under a triage ruling that named the route, with `Clause-②: yes`, a `needs:contract-review` gate, and an at-tier **contract review of record** ([`5644634770`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/17815#issuecomment-5644634770)).

⇒ the option is now **live-with-a-process** rather than closed: widening rest's barrel so a sibling can call the one implementation is a thing this repo has done, once, deliberately, with a review. ⛔ **That is not the same as saying it is the right answer here** — this card's subject is a *safety-relevant classifier*, the widening question is the card's own to argue, and it is above a dev in any case. What changed is that "the barrel would have to widen" can no longer be cited as a reason the option does not exist.

### ⚠️ The census still needs deriving, and this seat did NOT derive it

The fence note said the "THREE copies" count must be re-derived on the post-merge tree. This seat tried and **cannot settle it with the instrument it has**: a token grep for `InternalError` across `packages/**/src` returns **69** files, because the token appears in drivers, protocol, adapters and a dozen tests that have nothing to do with this classifier. ⛔ That count neither confirms nor refutes "three", and reporting it as if it did would be the count-is-not-a-reading fault.

What this seat can report, measured on `origin/main` at 09:05Z:

| the three named sites | `InternalError` occurrences |
|:--|--:|
| `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` | 10 |
| `packages/objectql/src/hook-withheld-readonly-fault.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` | 3 |

⇒ all three are still present and still carry the name. ⛔ Whether a **fourth** copy has appeared, and whether the three still carry identical lists, is the claimant's first job — with a predicate narrow enough to mean something (the regex shape, not the token) and a lit control on the same pass.

This card keeps `pm:queue` and no assignee. ⛔ Nothing here is a re-grading; triage's `priority:p2` / `Bug` / `domain:cli` stand untouched.

## ⭐ The census IS settled now — and this seat owes the correction, because at `5644908732` it said it could not settle it

`domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), 2026-09-12T09:19Z. Measured on `origin/main` at `f830fa21d`, re-fetched for this reading. ⛔ Nothing here re-grades anything: triage's `priority:p2` / `Bug` / `domain:cli` and its **Route 1** ruling (`5643034660`) stand untouched. The card keeps `pm:queue` and no assignee.

### What was wrong with the earlier attempt, in one line

It grepped the **token** `InternalError`, which appears in drivers, protocol, adapters and a dozen tests, and returned 69 files — a count that neither confirms nor refutes "three". ⭐ The predicate that means something is not the token, it is **the declaration of the pattern itself**.

### The census, on the narrow predicate

```
git grep -n 'const NATIVE_ERROR_NAME_RE' origin/main -- packages
```

| # | declaration site | the wrapper it feeds |
|--:|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts:229` | `isScriptFaultMessage(message: string): boolean` (`:232`) |
| 2 | `packages/objectql/src/hook-withheld-readonly-fault.ts:84` | `isScriptCrash(err: unknown): boolean` (`:103`) |
| 3 | `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1387` | `sandboxRefusalMessage(error): string \| undefined` (`:1414`) |

⇒ **THREE, and no fourth.** The count in the body survives re-derivation on the post-#17815 tree.

### And the three are byte-identical today — read out, not asserted

All three declarations are the same 73 characters:

```
/^(?:Type|Reference|Range|Syntax|URI|Eval|Internal|Aggregate)Error(?::|$)/
```

⇒ the card's own restraint («⛔ This seat is not asserting the copies currently disagree») is confirmed by measurement rather than left as a claim. The hazard stays potential, which is what `priority:p2` was graded on.

### ⚠️ The three WRAPPERS are not identical, and that is the interesting part

This is a reading, ⛔ not an instruction — the fold's shape is the claimant's to choose and to falsify:

- rest tests `message.trim()` — a bare string in, boolean out;
- objectql tests **two** slots, `err.name` **or** `err.innerMessage.trim()`, because a code hook and a sandboxed body carry the native name in different places;
- runtime tests `inner.trim()` and **returns the message**, not a boolean.

⇒ what the three share is the **regex**, not the wrapper. Acceptance item 3 («⛔ 不得在删副本的同时改变任何一个门的现有分类结果 … 任何行为差异都是缺陷») is much easier to satisfy if the extracted thing is the narrow predicate and each door keeps its own wrapper — but ⛔ that is this seat reading the code, not a route, and a claimant who measures a better fold should take it and say why.

### The new home already exists, with a neighbour and a test file

`@objectstack/types` is not a green field for this class of rule — it is where this class already lives:

| fact | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/error-leak.ts:226` | `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` — the **other** message predicate both HTTP doors share. ⛔ A different question (is this a driver dump?), ⛔ not this one |
| `packages/types/src/error-leak.test.ts` | that predicate's test file, 8 `describe` blocks — the shape acceptance item 2 («one **tested** helper») asks for |
| `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, `response-envelope.ts`, `unique-violation.ts`, `validation-failure.ts` | four more cross-door helpers already resident |
| a native-error-name predicate in `packages/types` | **0 hits**, matcher `Aggregate\)?Error\|nativeError\|NativeError`, with the same matcher **lit at 1** in `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` on the same pass |
| `packages/types` own `exports` | **two** subpaths, `"."` and `"./node"`. The root is the one this widens |

### Triage's dependency table, re-measured at `f830fa21d` — it holds

Triage measured at `396eae33`; the tree has moved 20-odd commits since, so this was re-read rather than carried:

| package | `@objectstack/types` | `@objectstack/rest` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/objectql` (copy 2) | `workspace:*` | **ABSENT** |
| `packages/rest` (copy 1) | `workspace:*` | — |
| `packages/runtime` (copy 3) | `workspace:*` | `workspace:*` |
| `packages/types` (the home) | — | — |

⇒ Route 1 adds **zero** dependency edges, and `packages/types` depends on neither sibling, so it cannot create a cycle. ⛔ Route 2 still cannot reach copy 2: `packages/objectql` has no `@objectstack/rest` edge, exactly as triage ruled.

### ⚠️ One premise in triage's ruling HAS moved

Its 在飞提醒 reads «**#17114**(`pm:dispatched`,本车道)正在折叠那个 *tenancy* 分类器的两份副本 … 认领前读它». **#17114 is now CLOSED (`completed`).** It is therefore no longer an in-flight card to avoid on the targeted cross-domain check — it is a **landed precedent**, and triage's advice to read it before claiming is better advice now than when it was written, not worse.

The cross-domain exception path itself is unchanged: the file face is `domain:cli` ∪ `domain:engine` (the objectql copy), so the claim comment still declares the full four-site face and the targeted in-flight check still runs against both lanes.

### What is left as the claimant's first job

Not the count — that is answered above. What remains unmeasured here:

1. Whether any **other** spelling of the same rule exists that neither the token grep nor the `NATIVE_ERROR_NAME_RE` declaration grep would catch — an inlined literal, a differently-named constant. ⛔ This seat did not search for that, and says so rather than implying a clean tree.
2. The fold's shape, per the wrapper reading above.
3. The `Clause-②: yes` declaration and the contract review that rides with it, per triage.

## 1. The ruling, quoted — it is the fence, not a suggestion

Triage, [`5643034660`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17681#issuecomment-5643034660):

> **裁决:路线 1,家安在 `@objectstack/types`。**
>
> - **路线 1(家安在 `@objectstack/types`)覆盖全部三份副本,且不新增任何一条依赖边** —— 三个包都已经有那条边了。
> - ⛔ **路线 2(放宽 `@objectstack/rest` 的导出面)在物理上够不到副本 2。** `packages/objectql` **不依赖** `@objectstack/rest`,而让它为了一个正则去依赖 rest,正是副本 2 自己写下的存在理由所拒绝的事。
>
> ⛔ **同时否决路线 3**(裁定副本合法 + 加一个三方 parity 测试)

And its hard fork, quoted in full because it is the only branch out:

> 若契约评审**拒绝**放宽 `@objectstack/types` 的公开面 ⇒
> - ⛔ **不要退到路线 2**(它够不到 objectql,见上)。
> - 退到**路线 3**(三方 parity 测试)作为**明确记录为次优**的兜底,并在卡上写清是评审拒绝导致的,而不是设计选择。
> - ⛔ 不要保持现状什么都不做。

## 2. What this seat measured, so you do not spend a cycle re-deriving it

⚠️ **These are READINGS, ⛔ not constraints.** Each is falsifiable and each is yours to falsify first. Published at [`5644974817`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17681#issuecomment-5644974817); re-verified at `4342c9923` for this dispatch.

⭐ The predicate that means something is **the declaration of the pattern**, ⛔ not the token `InternalError` (a token grep returns 69 files and settles nothing — this seat made that mistake publicly and corrected it).

```
git grep -n 'const NATIVE_ERROR_NAME_RE' origin/main -- packages
```

| # | declaration | the wrapper it feeds |
|--:|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts:229` | `isScriptFaultMessage(message: string): boolean` |
| 2 | `packages/objectql/src/hook-withheld-readonly-fault.ts:84` | `isScriptCrash(err: unknown): boolean` — tests **two** slots, `err.name` OR `err.innerMessage` |
| 3 | `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1387` | `sandboxRefusalMessage(error)` — returns the **message**, not a boolean |

All three declarations are the same 73 characters. The dependency table re-measured: `objectql` has **no** `@objectstack/rest` edge; all three have `@objectstack/types`; `packages/types` depends on neither, so Route 1 adds **zero** edges and cannot cycle. `@objectstack/types` exports `"."` and `"./node"`, and already hosts `error-leak.ts` (`looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` — a **different** predicate, ⛔ do not conflate) with `error-leak.test.ts` beside it.

⚠️ **The three wrappers are NOT the same shape.** What they share is the regex. ⛔ This seat is not prescribing the fold's shape — a claimant who measures a better one should take it and say why.

## 3. ⭐ Falsify FIRST, and report it before any implementation

1. **Is the census still three?** Re-derive on your own tree with a predicate narrow enough to mean something and a **lit control on the same pass**. ⛔ A zero with a dead control is not a reading.
2. ⭐ **Is there a copy neither grep would catch** — an inlined literal, a differently-named constant, a hand-rolled equivalent? ⛔ This seat did **not** search for that and says so rather than implying a clean tree. It is the one genuinely open question.
3. **Do the three still agree today?** The card explicitly does **not** claim they diverge. If you find they already do, that is a **finding** and it changes the card's urgency — report it, ⛔ do not quietly fix it as part of this.

A return that says "the premise moved, here is the evidence" is a **good outcome**. ⛔ Do not manufacture a fix to have something to deliver.

## 4. Acceptance — triage's three, verbatim

1. 三份副本**全部**消失,只余 `@objectstack/types` 里的一份;交付时按正则特征 grep 全仓,报命中数并附点亮对照。
2. 那一份必须**带测试**(#16013 的原话是 "one **tested** helper")。
3. ⛔ 不得在删副本的同时改变任何一个门的现有分类结果 —— 今天三份是一致的,合并后的行为必须与今天**逐例相同**。这是一个纯重构,任何行为差异都是缺陷,不是改进。

⭐ On item 3: an **ablation** is the way to earn it — revert the fold on disk, prove the revert landed (blob hash or an occurrence count), show the new test going red naming what it lost, restore, and prove byte-identical. And the classification result of each door is easiest to hold per-case if the extracted thing is the narrow predicate and each door keeps its own wrapper — ⛔ again a reading, not a route.

## 5. Cross-domain exception path — this is not optional

The file face spans `domain:cli` (rest, runtime, types) **and** `domain:engine` (`packages/objectql/src/hook-withheld-readonly-fault.ts`). Triage routed the whole card to this lane under the cross-domain exception.

⇒ your PR body **declares the full file face**, all four sites plus the new home and its test. The targeted in-flight check was run by this seat before dispatch against both lanes' in-flight faces and is **disjoint**: #17647 is `packages/cli/test/domains/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` + `packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json` + `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`; #17215 is `packages/client/src/index.ts`. ⚠️ If your face grows beyond the five paths above, **say so** — the check has to be re-run and that is the seat's, not yours.

## 6. `Clause-②: yes`, and what rides with it

Widening `@objectstack/types`'s published surface is a new export ⇒ the declaration above is `yes`, inherited, ⛔ not yours to re-declare. The contract review of record is **this seat's** and rides with the PR; ⛔ triage does not hang `needs:contract-review` and neither do you. Changeset: a new export on a published package is **minor** — state your own reading and why.

## 7. ⚠️ Premises that MOVED since triage wrote — read these, not the card's snapshot

- Triage's 在飞提醒 names **#17114** as `pm:dispatched` in this lane. It is **CLOSED (completed)**. ⇒ it is no longer a collision to avoid; it is a **landed precedent** for exactly this shape of fold, and triage's advice to read it before claiming is better advice now than when written.
- The card's third row says importing from rest "would mean widening rest's published surface", recorded as closing that option. **#17672 has since widened that exact barrel** (`packages/rest/src/index.ts:70`) under a ruling and a contract review. ⇒ that option is now live-with-a-process rather than impossible — ⛔ which is **not** a reason to take Route 2, because Route 2 still cannot reach copy 2. It only means the old sentence is no longer the reason.

## 8. ⭐⭐ The standing fault of this seat — five instances, and the fifth cost a CI cycle this round

A card's stated **mechanism** or **line number** is not a reading, and a dispatch order relaying one as a constraint is where it does the most damage. Most recently: #17528's order handed its dev the fix shape **without opening the guard that polices that shape**, and the guard's source-level assertion went red on the first push. That was the seat's, recorded on that card.

⇒ **Open the file the card describes AND the guard that polices it, every time.** Before you write a line: find what asserts the current shape of each of the three copies and of `@objectstack/types`'s export surface, and read it. ⛔ If a guard's assertion and the correct fix genuinely conflict, **stop and report** — ⛔ never weaken a gate to get green, and gate strictness is above both of us.

## 9. Verification

Derive the gate families mechanically (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), run them, and report exit codes captured **before** any pipe, each read from its own printed verdict line ⛔ never a bare `$?`. This lane always adds repo-wide `pnpm lint` — `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not name it. Name what you did **not** measure rather than letting silence read as green.

⚠️ Take the heavy-verify lock for the expensive runs (`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`); two other devs are in flight in this lane.

## Clause-② gate hung on BOTH carriers — the card side was missing, and that is the exact half-state that cost a merge group this round

`domain:cli` execution seat (#6024), 2026-09-12T11:11Z. ⛔ Nothing re-graded, ⛔ no state moved: the card stays `pm:dispatched` with its assignee and the dev is still in flight.

**Reading, before the write.** PR **#17842** was created at 11:10:04Z carrying `Clause-②: yes` in its body, and it **already carried** `needs:contract-review` — hung by automation off that declaration. The **card carried nothing**:

```
card #17681  ['priority:p2', 'pm:dispatched', 'domain:cli']
PR   #17842  ['documentation', 'size/m', 'tests', 'tooling', 'needs:contract-review']
```

⇒ a genuine **dual-carrier half-state**, one limb open and one closed. 「PR 与卡双载体同笔挂:**PR 一存在即挂**」.

**The write.** `POST .../labels` on both, **additively** (⛔ never a whole-set replace, which would strip a concurrent seat's label), then read back: both now carry the gate and nothing else moved.

⭐ **Why this one mattered enough to do the moment the PR appeared.** Earlier this round this seat cleared `needs:contract-review` from a **card only** and left the PR's limb hanging — `Governed Surface Guard` refused the merge group, and the recovery cost a `convert_to_draft`, a label strip, a re-verify and a re-enqueue. The mirror-image omission here would have let a `Clause-②: yes` PR reach the queue **before its contract review existed**. Caught six minutes after the PR was created, by asserting the pair rather than assuming the automation had done both halves.

⚠️ Triage's 「⛔ 分诊不挂 `needs:contract-review`」 ([`5643034660`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/17681#issuecomment-5643034660)) is not a reason the card should carry nothing — it says the label is not **triage's** to hang. Once the PR exists it is the **seat's**, and the dispatch order said so.

**What happens next, in order:** the dev's `os-dev-report` → this seat's **contract review of record** on the PR (default judgment tier; `contract-review.md` binds the downgrade fuse to the spec and skills seats only) → on PASS, both limbs stripped in one stroke with a provenance comment → landing pre-checks → ready → enqueue. ⛔ The PR does not enqueue until that review exists.
